title: dns-settings_soa
description: Components of the zone's SOA record.

expire.description: Time in seconds of being unable to query the primary server after which secondary servers should stop serving the zone.

min_ttl.description: The time to live (TTL) for negative caching of records within the zone.

mname.description: The primary nameserver, which may be used for outbound zone transfers.

refresh.description: Time in seconds after which secondary servers should re-check the SOA record to see if the zone has been updated.

retry.description: Time in seconds after which secondary servers should retry queries after the primary server was unresponsive.

rname.description: The email address of the zone administrator, with the first label representing the local part of the email address.

ttl.description: The time to live (TTL) of the SOA record itself.
